overview:
Lazygit's side panels were a fixed set of five (status, files, branches, commits, stash); this lets anyone editing their config reorder them, group several into tabs on one panel, hide the optional ones, or split a tab out into its own panel.
- A side panel is now a list of tab names (`SidePanel`) rather than one fixed name, so tabs can be grouped onto a shared panel or split into their own
- `files`, `branches`, and `commits` stay mandatory because other code focuses them directly; every other panel can be hidden or reordered
- Jump-to-panel keys bind positionally to however many panels are configured, instead of assuming exactly five
- Editing the config file and refocusing the terminal window reloads the panel layout live, re-applying the current repo's config while keeping the focused panel in place
- Panel sizing rules like the compact status and stash heights now key off the tab actually showing, not the panel's window name
verdict: Side panel layout moves from five hardcoded windows to a user-configurable, live-reloadable list of panels and tabs.

groups.title: Let users declare their side panel layout
groups.why: Adds the `SidePanel` type, the `SidePanels` config field, and `validateSidePanels` validation for the new `gui.sidePanels` key.

groups.title: Derive window layout and jump keys from the configured panels
groups.why: `SideWindows` and `sidePanelChildren` size and key panels by `ActiveViewForWindow` instead of a fixed five-panel list, and jump keys and window names follow the same config.

groups.title: Build, apply, and live-reload the side panels
groups.why: `applySidePanelConfig` and `assignSidePanelWindows` assign windows and tabs from `gui.sidePanels`, and a new `FocusEvents` channel lets `reloadSidePanels` re-apply it live when the terminal regains focus.
groups.flow_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Term as Terminal
    participant Driver as GuiDriver
    participant Gui as Gui
    Term->>Driver: sends FocusIn
    Driver->>Gui: emits FocusEvent
    Gui->>Gui: calls reloadSidePanels
    Gui->>Gui: calls applySidePanelConfig
    Gui->>Gui: calls moveDefaultTabsToTop
